verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows dLocal offering a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The LLM-friendly Markdown docs, llms.txt and MCP server are adjacent AI-access features, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
